reasons.action: The brief asks the car to pull forward out of the dark, an explicit performed movement, and since no visual reference exists, nothing else could govern the action; the request owns it.
reasons.medium: The only supplied asset is an audio engine rumble with an unknown/partial card, which cannot establish any rendering medium or style; with no visual reference in play, the rendering medium is left to the request.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference depicts a figure whose clothing or accessories could be retained, and the request names no garments or fittings; wardrobe therefore remains request-governed, with any dressing implied by the brief coming from the request itself.
reasons.lighting: There is no reference frame to supply lighting, so the darkness the car emerges from is simply part of the request's own description rather than a replacement of observed illumination; lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No reference contributes a camera composition or shot scale, and the 16:9 canvas is a delivery format rather than a camera instruction; framing is therefore governed by the request.
reasons.palette: No reference image supplies color or tonal grading, so the request governs palette by default; the brief's dark setting is the request's own description rather than an observed grade being overridden.
